name: hoptrace-workspace
description: HopTrace - ISP Network Fault Localisation, Physical Geography & Subscriber Operations

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('python', ['-m', 'uvicorn', 'app.main:app', '--reload', '--port', '8000', '--app-dir', 'backend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
